## What This File Is

The lookup table `auto-skill`'s Family Propagation Detection dereferences ("LOOKUP
families containing source skill", "GET propagation patterns from family_registry").

**It did not exist until 2026-07-22.** 37 skills referenced it; every lookup
resolved against nothing. Any past "no family propagation needed" verdict issued
in that window was unverified — it was a missing-file error reported as a clean
result. (SYM-001, auto-symmetry-hunter audit 2026-07-22.)

## Authority

A skill's **own sovereign-header `families:` field is the sole source of truth**
for membership. Prose family tables elsewhere are commentary, not authority.
The table above is regenerated from those headers:

```bash
python .claude/skills/_shared/regen_family_registry.py

``` ext

Exit 1 means the registry drifted from disk. Regenerate rather than hand-edit
the generated block; curated content below the marker survives regeneration.

`auto-skill/SKILL.md` — its "Skill Families" section now states membership is
generated-only ("MEMBERSHIP IS NOT LISTED HERE") and points here instead. The
`systems-lang`/`git-ci` phantom families and the old `rust-principal-developer` ext
/ `rust-code-reviewer` / `rust-tester` names (pre-2026-07-28 rename to
`techne-code-rust-*`) named below are historical evidence for the incident, not
a current state to reconcile against — **do not re-add a prose membership
table to auto-skill** on the theory that this divergence needs re-fixing.

**Phantom-family hazard:** propagating a rule into a family that exists only in
prose produces duplicated text with no registry backing — exactly what happened
on 2026-07-22, when a weak-test rule was copied into two files under a
"systems-lang FAMILY_PROPAGATION" label for a family that does not exist.

## Propagation Patterns

Only patterns with documented evidence are listed. An unlisted family means "no
propagation rule has been established yet" — **not** "propagate everything."

| Family | Propagates | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `coda-gtla-papers` | Internal receipt ceiling, no-self-certification, canonical terminal set, proof-ledger paths, public-surface hygiene, **research_layout companions (§5c)**, mechanism inventory only when reader-useful (§5b) | `_shared/coda_gtla_paper_compliance.md` — rules live in the contract ONCE; re-hosting inline is `DUPLICATE_RULE`; stage skills cite §5c, they do not fork the layout essay |
| `sprint-workflow` | Evidence invariant ("no evidence path = no credit"), gate ordering, BLOB submission format | `_shared/sprint_gates.md` |
| `meta` | Self-reference check, approval-before-apply, compressive-change law | auto-skill / auto-improve-autoskill / auto-symmetry-hunter constraints |
| `techne-code` | Authority ceiling (`AuthorityEffect::None`), producer/evaluator separation (producer never grades its own output; evaluator never patches), scope fence declared per skill, ACCEPT is a proposal not a promotion | each member's own Pipeline-position + Constraints sections (member list is the generated table above — do not hardcode a count here, it drifted once already); test rules by reference to `_shared/test_quality_law.md`, build rules by reference to `_shared/rust_build_policy.md` — inline copies are `DUPLICATE_RULE` (repaired 2026-07-28 and again 2026-07-28 for the rip-rust/rip-python siblings, which grew the family from 5 to 13 members and shipped with the family tag missing on 5 of them) |

### Propagate by reference, not by copy

When a rule belongs to 2+ members, extract it to `_shared/` and reference it.
Copying is the failure mode, not the fix: on 2026-07-17 the operator hand-edited
`rust-principal-developer` and `rust-tester` ten seconds apart (`b55cbe62f`,
`ef3e301bd`) to sync one identical line — evidence that duplication costs
maintenance every time it is touched. (SYM-006.)

## Orphan Policy

Skills in the "No Family Declaration" list above are invisible to propagation.
`techne-code-rust-tester` is the notable case: it carries the test-quality and
build-policy invariants but declares no family, so no correction will ever
reach it automatically.
